data.desc: Global Mofy AI Limited (Nasdaq: GMM) is a generative AI-driven technology solutions provider focused on virtual content production and digital assets. Through its proprietary Mofy Lab technology platform, which combines interactive 3D and artificial intelligence technologies, the Company creates high-definition virtual representations of physical-world objects, characters, and environments. Its digital assets and production capabilities support applications across film, television, animation, advertising, gaming, augmented and virtual reality, and other digital content industries. The Company is also expanding its AI-related activities through technology development, digital asset sales, investments, and industry partnerships.
